supplementary_document_crosscheck.interpretation: The supplied supplementary_data.pdf is DIRECTLY_INSPECTED evidence that it is not the manuscript's own official supplementary information. Its title, author correspondence list, and co-first-author order differ from the audited manuscript, and it addresses an exosome-secretion mechanism that the audited manuscript never mentions. It does, however, use the identical fusion-protein name and cell-line panel, consistent with being supplementary material for a separate, related follow-on publication by an overlapping author group (same corresponding author T. Kang) rather than an unrelated or fabricated document. No claim about intent, error, or validity of either publication follows from this observation; it only affects what this document can be used to verify.

findings.title: Supplied 'supplementary data.pdf' does not correspond to the audited manuscript's own supplementary information
findings.description: The document supplied to this audit as 'the supplementary data' for the manuscript is titled and authored differently from the manuscript, and covers an exosome-secretion mechanism absent from the manuscript's text, while reusing the manuscript's fusion-protein name and cell lines.
